author: WPB3
summary: Pre-alpha.1 research audit (CNA 7a64362e) profiling every renderer identity of that time: platform gates, dependencies, shader pipelines, the IGraphicsRenderer contract, capability polarity, verification tiers, facts and contradictions. Roughly half of it concerns retired renderer families. The current half is already on the renderer deep dives, the Development graphics pages and the rendering guide, mostly in corrected form (25 identities, 19 capabilities, 17 interfaces, WebGPU browser route, SDL_shadercross). The residue published is the list of contract comments that still lag the code at TARGET and CNA's defaults rule quoted beside the missing-vertex-input analysis.

concepts.text: The public renderer identity list is mechanically pinned: scripts/check_renderer_identities.py cross-checks the renderer enum against the CMake list of accepted names, so an identity cannot be added to one registry and forgotten in another.

concepts.text: Five GL-profile identities share the one EasyGL implementation: OPENGLES2 is the narrowest profile (GLSL ES 1.00 rewritten from the ES 3.00 corpus), OPENGLES3 is the Linux default, OPENGL33 is a desktop 3.3 core context, and WEBGL1/WEBGL2 are Emscripten-only with WEBGL2 the Emscripten default.
